Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api

Annotationsschnittstelle Internal

@Documented @Retention(CLASS) @Target({TYPE,METHOD,CONSTRUCTOR,FIELD}) public @interface Internal
Marks a type or member that is technically public but is not part of the supported API.

Annotated elements exist only so that the BetterNPCs implementation modules — which live in different jars and therefore cannot use package-private access — can reach them. They may change or disappear in any release, including a patch release, and the semantic versioning promise in ApiVersion does not cover them.

Third-party plugins must not call annotated members.
